preflight_blocker.reason: AFNI26.3.02 core has an official native Ubuntu24 ARM build, but the full current recipe unconditionally installs FreeSurfer7.4.1 from freesurfer-linux-centos7_x86_64-7.4.1.tar.gz through the shared template. Official7.4.1 distribution lists Linux x86_64/amd64 and macOS x86_64 only. AFNI @SUMA_Make_Spec_FS explicitly requires mris_convert, so this is a scientific workflow dependency, not an unused cosmetic file. No native Linux ARM7.4.1 packaged replacement is published. An ordinary documented supported native source configuration for that version was not established; this is a blocker for the existing packaged route, not a claim that every source build is impossible. Do not retain x86 binaries as ARM functionality, remove the dependency, upgrade the scientific dependency silently or introduce emulation/private ports.
preflight_blocker.historical_evidence_limit: Previous114/114 runs verified AFNI tests but never executed or architecture-checked bundled FreeSurfer mris_convert. Retain their actual AFNI outcomes without promoting complete dependency support.
